 Tanzania vs Nigeria Afcon qualifiers match preview
 Wia dis foto come from, Getty Images 
 Published 42 minutes wey don pass Read am in 2 mins Nigeria dey face Tanzania for di second time for dia Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign on Tuesday.
 Di match go hold away from home for di Amaan Stadium.
 Nigeria currently sit second for Group L, afta dem gain six points from three matches. Dem dey one point behind Guinea-Bissau, wey dey lead di group.
 Di Super Eagles start dia qualifying journey wit a 2-1 victory over Madagascar for home, but then suffer one heavy 3-0 loss away to Guinea-Bissau.
 For di first leg, Nigeria beat Tanzania wit korrect goals.

 Wetin happun for first leg
 Nigeria forward Tolu Arokodare na di man of di moment as e score two goals to keep di 2027 Africa Cup of Nations hope for Nigeria alive.
 Di player wey enta di match for second half score im first goal for 52 minutes. E score im second goal for 60 minutes.
 Arokodare miss plenti chances wey for make am score hat trick but Alhassan Yusuf early goal give Nigeria enuf ginger for di first half.
 Alhassan score for di second minute bifor Tanzania score dia only goal for di 32nd minute.
 Di most important tin be say Nigeria collect all di three points and di match end 3-1.
 for di first half and parts of di second half, di Taifa Stars bin also get dia m oments wey dem fail to convert.
 Nigeria still dey second for di table wit six points afta three matches while Tanzania dey bottom of di group.
 Guinea-Bissau still dey top Group L wit seven points.

 Nigeria : Nwabali (GK), Fredricks, Bassey, Aina; Ndidi, Bwene, Iwobi, Alhassan; Lookman; Adams, Nnadi
 Tanzania : Manula (GK); Chilambo, Mwamnyeto, Mlingo; Mao, Miroshi, Msanga, Kachwele, Denis, Hamad, Mnoga.
